# SpikeCodedAssociation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mechanism for matching detected objects across time steps using spike-based feature representations and temporal coincidence detection. Enables robust multi-object tracking without conventional frame-based correlation, showcasing a neuromorphic approach to temporal data association.
